input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides automatic successive one-year renewals (acceptable term length), but the non-renewal notice window is ninety (90) days, which exceeds the fallback ceiling of 60 days. It sits just short of walk-away territory (windows longer than 90 days), so the minimal fix is to shorten the window to 30 days to reach the preferred position, with 60 days offered as a fallback. The absence of a vendor renewal reminder and of a price-uplift cap is noted only in passing: fees here are calculated as a share of Net Sales rather than by a stated renewal price, and the agreement contains no uplift mechanic, so no cap is required.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from ninety to thirty days, consistent with our position that automatic twelve-month renewals must be exitable on 30 days' notice; we could live with 60 days if that is easier for you.
proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days
